1930s ka purana cinema hall (Assembly Hall), Mallital mein Flats ke kinare. Neeche Galaxy 12D, Chai Sutta Bar aur The Pahari Store.

51 Shaktipeethon mein se ek. Manyata hai ki yahan Mata Sati ki aankhein giri thin. Purana mandir 1880 ke bade bhooskhalan (landslide) mein nasht ho gaya tha, baad mein dobara banaya gaya. Jheel ke uttari kinare, Mallital mein.
Aapas mein judi pathreeli gufaon ka bagicha - gufaon ke naam jaanwaron par hain, jaise Tiger Cave aur Panther Cave.
Ayarpatta pahadi par. Angrez painter Dorothy Kellett ki yaad mein unke pati ne yahan seat banwayi thi. Picnic ke liye mashhoor.

Kaladhungi road ke hairpin ki nok par chai-maggi ke thele; wahan se ek kachcha raasta aur pathreeli seedhiyan cypress ke pedon ke beech ek khule kinare tak - neeche gehri ghaati aur door Khurpatal jheel.

Kaladhungi road ke mod par - Ghora Chaalak Seva Samiti ka adda. Yahin se ghode View Point, Tiger Top, Land's End, Forest Point, Tiffin Top aur Dorothy Seat ke 6 point tour par jaate hain (Rs 760). Chai ki dukaanon ke saath seedhiyan neeche Suicide Point tak.
Khurpatal View Point ke theek upar, hairpin ke andar sadak kinare Maa Mansa Devi ka chhota sa mandir - safed shikhar, laal darwaza aur gende ki maalaayein. Raahgir rukkar maatha tekte hain.
Khurpatal jheel ke theek upar ka view point - hare paani ki chhoti jheel aur seedhidaar khet.
Kilbury road par Nainital ka mashhoor view point. Saaf mausam mein yahan se Himalaya ki barfeeli chotiyan - Nanda Devi, Trishul aur Nanda Kot - dikhti hain.

Kumaon ki sabse mashhoor jheel, lagbhag 1,938 m ki unchai par. Aankh (nain) jaise aakar ki - manyata hai ki Mata Sati ki aankh yahan giri thi. Lambai lagbhag 1.4 km. Uttari sira Mallital, dakshini sira Tallital.
Lagbhag 2,270 m unchai. Mallital se ropeway (cable car) se pahunchte hain. Saaf mausam mein Nanda Devi samet Himalaya ki chotiyan dikhti hain.
Lover's Point se seedhiyan utarkar ek khula kinara - neeche gehri khaai aur saamne door tak ghaati. Railing ke peeche hi rahein.
Mall Road ka purana Catholic church (1868) - pathar ki deewarein aur laal nukeeli meenar.
Mallital ka purana bazaar - woolen kapde, Nainital ki mashhoor rang-birangi candles aur khaane-peene ki dukaanein.
Mallital ki safed sangmarmar ki masjid, Flats ke kinare. 1882 mein British fauj ke Muslim sipahiyon ke liye bani; ek oonchi meenar aur gumbad iski pehchaan hain.
Mallital mein Naina Devi mandir ke bilkul paas. Shaant mahaul, langar aur jheel ka sundar nazara.
Mallital se Tallital tak jheel ke kinare ki sadak, sarkari naam Govind Ballabh Pant Marg. Shaam ko lights aur jheel mein unka pratibimb dekhne laayak hai.
Nainital Boat Club - British daur ka purana yacht club. Jheel mein tairti safed paal wali yachts isi ki pehchaan hain.
Nainital ka sarkari zila aspataal (Mallital). Chot lagi ho ya tabiyat kharab, yahin aana.
Nainital ki sabse oonchi choti, lagbhag 2,615 m. Upar se poora shehar, jheel aur door Himalaya dikhte hain.
Nainital se ~5 km, Kaladhungi road par ek chhoti si jheel. Paas mein Woodland jharna aur chai-maggi ki dukaanein.
Pahadi raaste ka chhota mandir. Raahgir yahan ruk kar haath jodte hain.
Police station. Kuch gadbad ho - chori, jhagda, gunde - to yahan report karo.

Sariyatal ke neeche, Kaladhungi road par gate (ticket Rs 50). Pathar ki seedhiyan cypress ke jungle mein do jharnon tak jaati hain - neeche ke kund mein log nahaate hain.
Tallital ke paas ka public school.
Thandi Sadak par chattan mein bana chhota sa mandir - chattan par sindoor se Maa ki aakriti. Shaant aur pavitra jagah.
Uttarakhand Parivahan ka bus adda - Haldwani, Kathgodam, Delhi ki buses yahin se. Saamne jheel ke kinare Gandhi ji ki murti.
Uttarakhand ke Rajyapal ka nivas. 1897-1900 ke beech Buckingham Palace ki tarz par Gothic shaili mein bana. Saath mein golf course bhi hai.

A garden of interconnected rocky caves named after animals, like Tiger Cave and Panther Cave.
On Ayarpatta hill. Her husband built this seat in memory of the English painter Dorothy Kellett. A popular picnic spot.

Tea-and-Maggi carts at the tip of the Kaladhungi road hairpin; from there a dirt track and rocky steps run through the cypresses to an open edge - a deep valley below and Khurpatal lake in the distance.

On the Kaladhungi road bend - the pony owners' union stand. Ponies leave from here on the 6-point tour: View Point, Tiger Top, Land's End, Forest Point, Tiffin Top and Dorothy Seat (Rs 760). Steps beside the tea stalls lead down to Suicide Point.
Just above Khurpatal View Point, inside the hairpin by the road: a small shrine of Maa Mansa Devi - a white spire, a red door and marigold garlands. Passers-by stop to bow their heads.
A viewpoint right above Khurpatal lake - a small green-water lake and terraced fields.
Nainital's famous viewpoint on Kilbury road. On a clear day you can see the snowy Himalayan peaks - Nanda Devi, Trishul and Nanda Kot.
Kumaon's most famous lake, at about 1,938 m. Shaped like an eye (nain) - legend says Goddess Sati's eye fell here. About 1.4 km long. The north end is Mallital, the south end Tallital.
About 2,270 m high, reached by ropeway (cable car) from Mallital. On clear days you can see Himalayan peaks including Nanda Devi.
Down the steps from Lover's Point, an open edge - a deep drop below and the valley stretching far ahead. Stay behind the railing.
Mall Road's old Catholic church (1868) - stone walls and a pointed red spire.
Mallital's old market - woollens, Nainital's famous colourful candles and food stalls.
Mallital's white marble mosque by the Flats. Built in 1882 for the Muslim soldiers of the British army; a tall minaret and a dome are its marks.
Right next to Naina Devi temple in Mallital. Peaceful, with langar and a lovely view of the lake.
The lakeside road from Mallital to Tallital, officially Govind Ballabh Pant Marg. Its evening lights reflected in the lake are worth seeing.
Nainital Boat Club - a historic yacht club from the British era. The white-sailed yachts on the lake are its trademark.
Nainital's government district hospital (Mallital). Hurt or unwell? Come here.
Nainital's highest peak, about 2,615 m. You can see the whole town, the lake and the distant Himalayas.
A small lake ~5 km from Nainital on the Kaladhungi road. Nearby: the Woodland waterfall and tea-and-Maggi stalls.
A little wayside shrine on the hill path. Passers-by stop here and fold their hands.
The police station. Trouble - theft, a fight, goons? Report it here.
Pt. G.B. Pant High Altitude Zoo on Sher ka Danda hill, about 2,100 m up - home to mountain animals and birds.
Below Sariyatal, a gate on the Kaladhungi road (ticket Rs 50). Stone steps run through a cypress forest to two waterfalls - people bathe in the pool below.
A small shrine in the rock on Thandi Sadak - the Goddess's face is painted on the rock in sindoor. Quiet and sacred.
The Uttarakhand Roadways bus stand - buses to Haldwani, Kathgodam and Delhi leave from here. Gandhi ji's statue stands opposite, by the lake.
Residence of the Governor of Uttarakhand. Built 1897-1900 in Gothic style, modelled on Buckingham Palace. It also has a golf course.
A grand view of Khurpatal lake and the deep valley below.
Ponies take you from here to Tiffin Top and Land's End. On the Kaladhungi road, about 3 km from Nainital.
Boats for hire. Press E at a boat, row with W/joystick, turn with A/D. Press E at any jetty to get off.
Come, have a look at these warm shawls - straight from Kashmir!
Tea, with ginger! Have some hot tea in this cold.
Hot roasted corn! Shall I add lemon and masala?
Jai Maa Naina Devi! Whatever you wish for with a true heart comes true here.
A photo with the lake? My brother has a camera.
Roasted on coals, bhai - try it once.
Shall I make you Maggi? Maggi tastes different in the hills.
We have momos too - steamed, with red chutney.
Need a boat, sir? One hour, I'll take you round the whole lake!
Take a special Nainital candle home, everyone will love it.
A huge fair is held here during Navratri.
Twenty-five rupees each, two for fifty.
Take some prasad, child - it's the Mother's blessing.
I'll give you a fair price, you're one of us.
The lake is prettiest in the evening - take a boat now.
Yacht sailing is run by the Boat Club, that's separate.
Look at this whistle toy - everyone takes one.
Naina Devi temple is straight ahead towards Mallital.
See the Mall Road lights in the evening - the reflections on the lake are amazing!
You can go boating from both Tallital and Mallital.
A ropeway goes up to Snow View - you can see the Himalayas from there.
Take an evening walk on Thandi Sadak, it's very peaceful.
Do check out the candles and woollens in Bada Bazar.
Trek up to Tiffin Top (Dorothy's Seat) - the view is great.
Be careful in the back lanes at night, some thugs roam around!
Had momos yet? Mall Road has the best ones.
The lake is shaped like an eye, that's why it's called Naini.
Parking is a real problem here - just park at Tallital.
You get cheap jackets in the Tibetan market, take a look.
Watch out for the monkeys, they snatch chips and run!
In peak season it's so crowded you can barely walk on Mall Road.
Hey, why are you hitting me?!
Hey! Where do you think you're going?
You're full - come back a bit later!
Your pockets are empty! Earn money from missions.
First day in Nainital! First visit Maa Naina Devi, then grab some hot food, then enjoy the lake view.
Go to Naina Devi Temple and pay your respects
Eat something at a food stall (E)
Come back to the lake shore

Take a boat from the jetty (E)

Deliver a parcel to the Snow View cafe - you have 7 minutes. On foot or by car, your call!

Chase off 3 monkeys (sprint at them with Shift)
A travel blogger needs photos of Nainital's best viewpoints. Visit them all!
